test.//: Enforce 1:1 mirroring: every src/{domain}/{Project} must have tests/{domain}/{Project}.Tests

purge.//: Remove all TestResults directories to force a clean test run

commands: find tests -name TestResults -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true

coverage:purge.//: Remove all coverage artifact files from TestResults directories. Run locally before a full coverage run to ensure fresh results. Do NOT run in CI.

coverage:upload.//: Sync Codecov flags from the current project graph, then upload all coverage.cobertura.xml files found under tests/. Assumes tests have already been run. Requires CODECOV_TOKEN env var and the codecov CLI on PATH.
